'''Jun-Muk Hwang''' ({{Korean|hangul=황준묵}}; born 27 October 1963) is a South Korean mathematician, specializing in [[algebraic geometry]] and complex [[differential geometry]].<ref name=KIAS>{{cite web|title=Hwang, Jun-Muk / School of Mathematics|website=Korea Institute for Advanced Study|url=http://www.kias.re.kr/sub03/sub03_01_02_01_01.jsp?empid=MTAwNjg=|access-date=2018-09-11|archive-date=2021-12-05|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20211205070944/http://www.kias.re.kr/sub03/sub03_01_02_01_01.jsp?empid=MTAwNjg=|url-status=dead}}</ref>

==Personal life==
Hwang is the eldest son of ''[[gayageum]]'' musician [[Hwang Byungki]] and novelist [[Han Malsook]].<ref>{{cite news|url=http://news.khan.co.kr/kh_news/khan_art_view.html?artid=201411151139431&code=960100|author=임아영 [Im A-yeong]|script-title=ko:[우리시대의멘토]국악인 황병기|newspaper=[[Kyunghyang Shinmun]]|date=15 November 2014|access-date=12 September 2018}}</ref>

==Education and career==
Hwang studied physics at [[Seoul National University]] for his bachelors before studying physics at [[Harvard University]]. In 1993, he completed his PhD under the direction of [[Yum-Tong Siu]] with thesis '' Global nondeformability of the complex hyper quadric''.<ref>{{MathGenealogy|id = 18817}}</ref><ref>{{cite thesis |url= https://dl.acm.org/doi/book/10.5555/920240 |title= Global nondeformability of the complex hyperquadric |author=<!--Not stated--> |website= ACM Digital Library |year= 1993 |publisher= [[Association for Computing Machinery]] |access-date= 5 January 2021 |type= phd |quote= }}</ref> In the following years he held positions at the University of Notre Dame, the [[Mathematical Sciences Research Institute]], and Seoul National University. Since 1999, he was a professor at the [[Korea Institute for Advanced Study]].<ref name=KIAS/> He was in 2006 an invited speaker with talk ''Rigidity of rational homogeneous spaces'' at the [[International Congress of Mathematicians]] (ICM) in [[Madrid]]<ref>{{cite book|chapter-url=http://www.icm2006.org/proceedings/Vol_II/contents/ICM_Vol_2_28.pdf|chapter=Rigidity of rational homogeneous spaces|title=International Congress of Mathematicians, Madrid, 2006|volume=II|pages=613–626|publisher=Eur. Math. Soc.|location=Zurich|year=2006}}</ref> and in 2014 a plenary speaker with talk ''Mori geometry meets Cartan geometry: Varieties of minimal rational tangents'' at the ICM in [[Seoul]].<ref>{{cite arXiv|title=Mori geometry meets Cartan geometry: Varieties of minimal rational tangents|year=2015|eprint=1501.04720|last1=Hwang|first1=Jun-Muk|class=math.AG}}</ref>

{{blockquote|With his collaborator [[Ngaiming Mok]], he has developed the theory of varieties of minimal rational tangents, which combines methods of algebraic geometry and differential geometry in the study of rational curves on algebraic varieties. He has applied this theory to settle a number of problems on algebraic varieties covered by rational curves.<ref name=KIAS/>}}

In 2020, he was the founding director of the Center for Complex Geometry at the [[Institute for Basic Science]].<ref>{{cite web |url= https://www.ibs.re.kr/cop/bbs/BBSMSTR_000000000739/selectBoardArticle.do?nttId=19062 |title= 	IBS launches the IBS Center for Complex Geometry |author=<!--Not stated--> |date= 31 August 2020 |website= [[Institute for Basic Science]] |publisher= |access-date= 21 January 2021 |quote= }}</ref> In 2023, he was selected to be on the committee for the [[Abel Prize]].<ref>{{cite web |url= https://abelprize.no/page/abel-committee |title= The Abel Committee |author= <!--Not stated--> |date= |website= The Abel Prize |publisher= |access-date= 3 April 2023 |quote= |language= }}</ref><ref>{{cite web |url= https://biz.chosun.com/science-chosun/science/2023/03/22/2YPCEIZDURESFI4U2F3DHT6SXU/ |script-title=ko:'수학계 노벨상' 아벨상 수상자에 루이스 카파렐리 미국 오스틴 텍사스대 교수 |author= 홍아름 |date= 22 March 2023|website=[[ChosunBiz]] |publisher= |access-date= 3 April 2023 |quote= |language= Korean}}</ref>

==Awards and honors==
*2021: [[National Academy of Sciences Award]], [[National Academy of Sciences of the Republic of Korea|National Academy of Sciences]], South Korea<ref>{{cite web |url= https://www.ibs.re.kr/cop/bbs/BBSMSTR_000000000736/selectBoardArticle.do?nttId=20438&pageIndex=1&searchCnd=&searchWrd= |script-title=ko:황준묵 단장, '제66회 대한민국학술원상' 수상 |author= 권예슬 |date= 27 September 2021 |website= [[Institute for Basic Science]] |publisher= |access-date= 17 January 2023 |quote= |language= Korean}}</ref>
*2012: Fellow, [[American Mathematical Society]]
*2010: [[National Scientist of the Republic of Korea]], [[Ministry of Education, Science and Technology (South Korea)|Ministry of Education, Science and Technology]]
*2009: [[Ho-Am Prize in Science]], Am Prize, The Ho Am Foundation
*2007: Fellow, [[Korean Academy of Science and Technology]]
*2006: [[Top Scientist and Technologist Award of Korea]], {{ill|Korean Federation of Science and Technology Societies|ko|한국과학기술단체총연합회}}<ref>{{cite web |url=https://m.yakup.com/news/index.html?mode=view&nid=48245 |title= 김성훈 교수 대한민국 최고과학기술인상 선정 |author= 임세호 |date= 21 April 2006 |website= The Yakup (약업신문) |publisher= |access-date= 16 November 2023 |quote= |language= Korean}}</ref>
*2006: Scientist of the Year Award, Korean National Assembly<!--대한민국 국회 과학기술대상-->
*2001: [[Korea Science Award]], Ministry of Science and Technology<!--제8회 한국과학상 수상-->
*2000: Award for Excellent Article, [[Korean Mathematical Society]]<ref>{{cite web |url= http://www.kias.re.kr/sub02/sub02_01_01.jsp?empid=MTAwNjg= |title= Hwang, Jun-Muk / School of Mathematics |author= <!--Not stated--> |date=  |website= [[Korea Institute for Advanced Study]] |publisher=  |access-date= 20 January 2021 |quote=  |archive-date= 21 January 2021 |archive-url= https://web.archive.org/web/20210121050055/http://www.kias.re.kr/sub02/sub02_01_01.jsp?empid=MTAwNjg%3D |url-status= dead }}</ref>
